title: Identification of the specified structural exceptional dualizing object
statement: Fix a finite-field datum D, a prime l distinct from D.p, an evaluation-normalized realization family R, and a separated finite-type model X. Put Y = X base changed to the algebraic closure. Let B be a common-stage Verdier duality datum [def-sf-common-stage-verdier-data], and assume its Dualizing clause. For every normalized structural exceptional coefficient system S [lem-sf-weil-native-exceptional-forgetful] and every compactification c of the structure morphism Y to Spec(D.k), B.omega is isomorphic to the closed-coefficient exceptional image (S_c)^! of geometricPointOmega, the actual common-stage coefficient tensor unit. This statement makes no assertion about a bidual arrow or about native adjoints.

source.place: Paragraph 1: the dualizing object supplied by the exceptional adjoint; final paragraph: the same coefficient comparisons and adjunction units and counits.

proof.text: Use the finite dualizing identifications in B.Dualizing at the least coefficient field. Its auxiliary exceptional system and the specified S have isomorphic rational compact-support functors at the canonical compactification, by their rationalLeft comparisons to the same operation. Transport the first adjunction along this left isomorphism and apply uniqueness of right adjoints. Compose with B.omegaComparison and the commonComparison.b component for S.
Choose a common refinement of the canonical compactification and c. The two specified closed-coefficient right refinement isomorphisms identify their exceptional functors.

The regular completed coefficient and the reconstructed integral tensor unit have isomorphic coherent reductions: use regularCoefficient_coherentReduction and pullbackTensorIntegralUnitReduction. Full faithfulness of integralSystemReduction lifts the isomorphism. Apply rational localization and the least-stage inclusion to identify CoefQbarVerdier.coefficientUnit with geometricPointOmega. Apply the exceptional right functor to this isomorphism and compose all factors. Every factor is an isomorphism, including for the empty scheme and zero coefficients in the zero category.

proof_origin.place: Formal assembly of the dualizing-object identification from the existing normalized coefficient and adjoint comparisons.

lean.statement:
theorem structural_dualizing_identification
    (D : FiniteFieldDatum.{u}) (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] [Fact (l ≠ D.p)]
    (R : Family l D) (X : Space D)
    (B : CoefQbarVerdier.Duality D l (Fact.out : l ≠ D.p) (PadicAlgCl l)
      (geometric D X).base.left)
    (hB : CoefQbarVerdier.Dualizing D l (Fact.out : l ≠ D.p) (PadicAlgCl l)
      (geometric D X).base.left B)
    (S : StructuralSystem D l X)
    (c : Compactification (geometric D X).base.hom) :
    Nonempty (B.omega ≅ (S.ring.operation c .closed).G.obj (geometricPointOmega D l R))
